name: MediaChat
promise: Answers that show the clip, the image and the table, in the language the customer asked in.
suggested: How do I reset the device?
how_it_works: Your question, in any language, goes to this app.
The app asks the Knowledge Box; the answer comes back in your language with the exact clip, image or page it came from.
Media is streamed through this app, never from the knowledge service directly.
